title: Pointwise left Kan extensions of coherent ordinary-indexed diagrams
statement:
Use universes, nerves, quasicategories, coherent functor categories, transformations, mapping spaces and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal U$ be a universe, $u:A\to J$ a functor between $\mathcal U$-small ordinary categories, and $\mathcal B$ a quasicategory admitting all $\mathcal U$-small colimits. The quasicategory $\mathcal B$ may lie in a larger universe and need not have $\mathcal U$-small mapping spaces. Precomposition $u^*:\operatorname{Fun}(N(J),\mathcal B)\to\operatorname{Fun}(N(A),\mathcal B)$ has a left adjoint $u_!$, meaning a coherent functor and unit inducing natural equivalences of whole mapping spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(N(J),\mathcal B)}(u_!F,G)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(N(A),\mathcal B)}(F,u^*G).$$
For $j\in J$, define $(u\downarrow j)$ to have objects $(a,\alpha:u(a)\to j)$ and morphisms $r:(a,\alpha)\to(a',\alpha')$ with $\alpha=\alpha' u(r)$. There are coherent natural equivalences
$$(u_!F)(j)\simeq\operatorname{colim}_{(a,\alpha)\in N(u\downarrow j)}F(a).$$
The structure maps in $j$ are induced by postcomposition of $\alpha$, and the unit at $a$ is the colimit leg indexed by $(a,1_{u(a)})$. These formulas and the adjunction hold with arbitrary coherent simplicial parameters in any containing universe: postcomposition by $u_!$ is left adjoint to postcomposition by $u^*$ on the corresponding parameter functor categories, compatibly with evaluation and restriction of parameters. For a natural transformation $\theta:u\to v$ between ordinary functors $A\to J$, the maps $(v\downarrow j)\to(u\downarrow j)$, $(a,\alpha)\mapsto(a,\alpha\theta_a)$, give a transformation $v_!\to u_!$. Its adjoint mate is $u^*\to v^*$ induced by $\theta$, and these transformations are coherent under identities, composition and higher simplices of $N\operatorname{Fun}(A,J)$.

Enlarge to a universe containing B before applying the local-smallness hypothesis of Proposition 6.4.9; only the displayed U-small comma colimits are required, not all colimits in the enlarged universe. The comma maps in the last clause give the adjoint mates of restriction transformations. Read online, July 30 2026 revision; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical theorem.
